id: Harry Potter and the Chamber of Secrets (2002)

facts.why: Wikipedia's plot has Dobby sabotaging an important dinner with Vernon's client, but nothing opened names Aunt Petunia's violet cream puffs. The name now points to the dinner only.
No treacle toffee appears in the film or its plot. Hagrid's fudge is a book detail, so the name drops his claim.

facts.text: Ronald Weasley, you flew a car to school! Sit down, all of you, and eat before it goes cold.
facts.why: At the Burrow Molly's real line is 'you best hope I don't put bars on your window, Ronald Weasley! Come on, Harry, time for a spot of breakfast.' She tells Arthur the boys flew the car to Surrey. The 'to school' telling off is the Howler later at Hogwarts, so the timing is off for a breakfast note.
facts.fix: Ronald Weasley, you flew that car to Surrey! Sit down, all of you, and eat before it goes cold.

fix_note.text: Ronald Weasley, you flew that car to Surrey! Sit down, all of you, and eat before it goes cold.

facts.why: The transcript has Dobby freed when Lucius hands him a sock hidden in the diary. No pillowcase shows in the sources opened.

vibe.verdict: A Burrow kitchen with the Howler cue, flying car pies, Polyjuice jelly, Dobby's pudding and the rubber duck scone, though the recipe box look is generic.
ideas: Swap 'Hagrid's treacle toffee' for 'Dobby's sock cookies' (Harry tricks Lucius into freeing Dobby with a sock).
Swap 'Bubbling potion jelly' for 'Polyjuice jelly' (Harry and Ron as Crabbe and Goyle).
Swap 'Burrow shepherd's pie' note for 'Molly's breakfast the morning after the flying car rescue'.
Add a Howler-red envelope napkin prop (Ron's Howler at the Gryffindor table).
iconic: Flying car and the Whomping Willow (pies, wink)
Follow the spiders, not the butterflies (drink note, wink)
The basilisk and Tom Riddle's diary (wink)
changed: House drink note now Ron's butterflies line
Howler slip line now Go on, Ron
Last wink now the basilisk and Riddle's diary
